messages:
Jordan N: Heads-up — preflight flagged the prompt-suite sanity check for release candidate 2026-03-15-rc3. See dashboard: https://dash.redwood.dev/evals/rc3
Jordan N: Delta looks like +5.9% failures on the 'customer-summary' prompts, latency steady tho. Holding the release until we decide.
deploybot: Preflight run 1719998888 results: QUALITY_GATE=FAIL
deploybot: Summary: prompt-suite 'customer-summary' failed thresholds (precision drop 5.9%), affected model variant: rc3. Logs: https://logs.redwood.dev/preflight/1719998888
Sachin P: Oof. Do we have a quick bisect candidate? Last model change was a tokenizer tweak + attention-kernel swap.
Maria L: Tokenizer tweak seems suspicious. Can we pin to rc2 for this release and run a targeted ablation on the tokenizer change?
Kyle B: I support pin. Suggested plan: 1) Pin traffic for stable route to rc2, 2) Run canary at 5% to rc3 with extra eval hooks, 3) If canary ok, promote. Otherwise rollback rc3.
Sachin P: Agree. Minimal blast radius. Also want a short change-window extension — add 1 hour to the maintenance window so QA can validate.
Jordan N: Ok. If we go pin, we should update release notes and the ops runbook with rollback steps. Maria, can you approve pin and the window extension?
Maria L: Approving pin to rc2 for the release and +1h change window. :white_check_mark:
Jordan N: @deploybot please execute: `pin-version --service summarizer --from rc3 --to rc2 --reason "preflight prompt-suite regression"`
deploybot: Command received. Executing pin...
deploybot: Pin complete. Routing updated: summarizer -> rc2 (stable). Canary (summarizer@rc3) deployed at 5% for 15m with extra eval hooks.
Sachin P: Running tokenizer ablation now against the same prompts, will post quick diff in ~10m.
Jordan N: I updated the release notes draft: added note about reverting tokenizer change pending bisect. Link: https://docs.redwood.dev/releases/2026-03-15-draft
Kyle B: Rollback steps for ops (copied to runbook):
```
# rollback summarizer rc3 -> rc2
deploybot rollback --service summarizer --to rc2
verify /evals/prompt-suite sanity
monitoring alert: summary-regressions
```
Maria L: If canary fails, we revert rc3 entirely and open an incident if impact > 5% customer-facing failures. Otherwise we proceed with rc2 release.
deploybot: Canary evaluation complete: pass metrics within thresholds for canary period (15m). No regression on canary traffic sample.
Sachin P: Ablation results: tokenizer tweak correlates with most failures. Patch branch ready: `tokenizer-fix/escape-handling`. Recommend hotfix after release.
Jordan N: Sounds good. Proceed with rc2 release, ship notes noting hotfix followup. Thanks team.
Maria L: Approved release with rc2 and follow-up hotfix. :rocket:
